title: Terminology
description: The terminology file, definitions/terminology/global.yml. Terms define the words conventions use; aliases record the words to avoid and where; display forms say how a token is written in a Title-Cased name.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape. Always 1.

display_forms.description: How identifier tokens are written when a name is derived from them, e.g. api is written API.

token.description: The lower-case token as it appears in a filename or directory name.

display.description: How the token is written in a display name.

term.description: One term. It either defines itself (definition) or points at the upstream document that does (authority) -- never both, so a definition is never restated in two places.

display_name.description: How the term is written in prose.

token.description: The identifier token, when the term names one, e.g. validate. Required for terms tagged gha.responsibility, gha.capability, gha.action or outputs.kind.

authority.description: The upstream document that defines this term. The term is listed so it can be linked and found, not redefined.

anchor.description: The heading anchor within that document, without the leading #.

tags.description: Groupings the tooling projects from, e.g. gha.responsibility builds the list of workflow responsibility tokens.

stability.description: stable: changing it is a breaking change; provisional: may still change in a minor release.

deprecated.description: Set when the term should no longer be used.

alias.description: A word to avoid in favour of the term. banned aliases fail; discouraged ones warn. scope says where: prose (checked by the MusherConventions Vale style) or identifier (filenames, IDs and other names, checked by the conventions that govern them).

text.description: The word or phrase to avoid, in lower case.

suggest.description: What to write instead, when that is not simply the term itself (its token in identifiers, its display name in prose).
